title_zh: 黄永玉 · 永远长不大的老头
title_en: Huang Yongyu · The Old Man Who Never Grew Up

lines: 1924年，黄永玉出生在湖南。
In 1924, Huang Yongyu was born in Hunan.
他在湘西凤凰长大——沱江水，吊脚楼，青石板路，是他心里最早的画。
He grew up in Fenghuang — the Tuo River, stilt houses and stone lanes were the first pictures in his heart.
十二岁那年，他离开家乡，一路漂泊。
At twelve, he left home and drifted from place to place.
没进过美术学院，他就凭一把刻刀，自学木刻，刻出了自己的天地。
With no art school, he taught himself woodcut, carving out a world of his own with a single knife.
他的表叔，是写《边城》的作家沈从文。
His uncle was Shen Congwen, the writer of Border Town.
1953年，他来到北京，在中央美术学院教版画。
In 1953, he moved to Beijing to teach printmaking at the Central Academy of Fine Arts.
七十年代，他画了一只睁一只眼、闭一只眼的猫头鹰。
In the 1970s, he painted an owl with one eye open and one eye shut.
这只猫头鹰给他惹来了大麻烦，可他还是笑眯眯的，接着画。
That owl got him into big trouble — but he just smiled, and kept on painting.
1980年，他设计的猴年邮票发行了。
In 1980, his Year of the Monkey stamp was issued.
红底上一只小金猴，成了新中国第一枚生肖邮票，也成了几代人的集邮记忆。
A little golden monkey on red — China's first zodiac stamp, and a treasured memory for generations.
他爱画荷花，大红大绿，热热闹闹。
He loved painting lotuses — bold reds and greens, full of life.
他还写散文、写小说，八十多岁开始写长篇，一写就是好多年。
He wrote essays and novels too; in his eighties he began a long novel, and kept at it for years.
他抽烟斗，养狗，九十岁还开跑车，大家都叫他“老顽童”。
He smoked a pipe, kept dogs, and drove a sports car at ninety — people called him the Old Rascal.
九十八岁那年，他还为兔年邮票画了一只蓝色的兔子。
At ninety-eight, he drew a blue rabbit for the Year of the Rabbit stamp.
2023年夏天，黄永玉走了，享年九十九岁。
In the summer of 2023, Huang Yongyu passed away, aged ninety-nine.
可那只猴子、那只猫头鹰、那池荷花，还在对我们眨眼睛。
Yet his monkey, his owl and his lotus pond are still winking at us.
一个永远长不大的老头。
An old man who never grew up.
